## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at Victoria Embankment.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Use the Uber Boat by Thames Clippers return ticket to travel along the Thames. Choose from many stops in the Central and East zones, including Tower Pier, London Eye, and Greenwich.
>
> Enjoy a ride on the IFS Cloud Cable Car with a return ticket. Fly over the River Thames and see the Olympic Park, The O2, and London’s skyline views.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €47.51. It was rated 3.4 out of 5 from 5 ratings and 2 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
